name: Quake II — generic engine
summary: For a Quake II engine this build has no profile for: only the switches id Software's own Quake II documented.
description:
The fallback. It sends the vocabulary every id-derived Quake II engine inherited from the original: the `basedir`, `game` and `maxclients` cvars set with `+set`, `+map`, and `+connect`. Nothing else, because everything else is a port's own invention and an engine that does not recognise a switch is an engine that will not start.

That is why this profile uses `+set basedir` where the Yamagi profile uses `-datadir`: `-datadir` is Yamagi's, and `+set basedir` is the one an unknown Quake II engine can be relied on to understand. Yamagi accepts it too, and says it is deprecated — which is the right trade for a profile whose whole job is to work on an engine nobody here has identified.

There is no `host_dedicated` action. Whether a particular build has a dedicated server in it at all is exactly what a generic profile cannot know, and a button that started nothing would be worse than no button.

Quake II support in Auto-Pigeon is work in progress. Core editing is available, but some textures, entities, compilation and engine workflows may be incomplete, and this profile is part of that path.
